title: Oracle Eloqua connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [Oracle Eloqua connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/oracle-eloqua) is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

Use the connector to ingest marketing data such as contacts, accounts, campaigns, email and form assets, form submissions, events, and website visitors from Oracle Eloqua into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth user-to-machine (U2M) authentication and supports incremental ingestion, UI-based pipeline authoring, Declarative Automation Bundles, and API-based pipeline authoring.
